module TopModule(
    input  a,
    input  b,
    input  sel,
    output out
);

always @* begin
    if (sel == 0) begin
        out = a;
    end else begin
        out = b;
    end
end

endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  a,
    input  b,
    input  c,
    input  d,
    output min
);

always @* begin
    if (a < b) begin
        if (a < c) begin
            if (a < d) begin
                min = a;
            end
            else begin
                min = d;
            end
        end
        else begin
            if (c < d) begin
                min = c;
            end
            else begin
                min = d;
            end
        end
    end
    else begin
        if (b < c) begin
            if (b < d) begin
                min = b;
            end
            else begin
                min = d;
            end
        end
        else begin
            if (c < d) begin
                min = c;
            end
            else begin
                min = d;
            end
        end
    end
end

endmodule

module TopModule(
    input clk,
    input w,
    input R,
    input E,
    input L,
    output Q
);

always @(posedge clk)
begin
    if (E)
    begin
        if (L)
        begin
            Q <= R;
        end
        else
        begin
            Q <= w;
        end
    end
end

endmodule

module TopModule(
    input clk,
    input shift_ena,
    input count_ena,
    input data,
    output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (shift_ena) begin
        q <= {q[3:1], data};
    end
    if (count_ena) begin
        q <= q - 1;
    end
end

endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  mode,
    input  too_cold,
    input  too_hot,
    input  fan_on,
    output heater,
    output aircon,
    output fan
);

always @* begin
    if (mode == 1) begin // heating mode
        if (too_cold == 1) begin // turn on heater when it is too cold
            heater = 1;
        end
        else begin // turn off heater when it is not too cold
            heater = 0;
        end
        if (fan_on == 1) begin // turn on fan when fan_on is high
            fan = 1;
        end
        else begin // turn off fan when fan_on is low
            fan = 0;
        end
        aircon = 0; // turn off air conditioner when in heating mode
    end
    else begin // cooling mode
        if (too_hot == 1) begin // turn on air conditioner when it is too hot
            aircon = 1;
        end
        else begin // turn off air conditioner when it is not too hot
            aircon = 0;
        end
        if (fan_on == 1) begin // turn on fan when fan_on is high
            fan = 1;
        end
        else begin // turn off fan when fan_on is low
            fan = 0;
        end
        heater = 0; // turn off heater when in cooling mode
    end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input L,
  input clk,
  input [2:0] r,
  output reg [2:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (L) begin
    q <= r;
  end else begin
    q <= {q[1] ^ q[2], q[0], q[2]};
  end
end

endmodule
